scores.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation after adding schema compilation at `register` time and a private `getValidator` helper. Crucially, `ToolRegistry.execute` was never modified to actually call `getValidator` or validate the input, meaning the core feature does not work and three of the four tests in the newly added `registry.acceptance.test.ts` fail. Furthermore, `getValidator` is an unused private method which will fail TypeScript/ESLint checks. Most of the acceptance criteria—including almost all tests in `registry.test.ts`, the orchestrator test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the one-line JSDoc on `execute`, and the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`—are completely missing, while an unwanted `.lore/dod.md` file was left in the tree.
